content.short: OpenZeppelin Relay enables sending transactions via an HTTP API, automating smart contract operations securely.
content.description: OpenZeppelin Relay enables developers to submit transactions via a standard HTTP API. Defender Relay offers a gasless meta-transaction relay designed for a seamless, cost-efficient experience. The system handles resubmissions, secure private key storage, and transaction signing, so developers do not need to monitor activity or maintain backend scripts to manage keys. By centralizing signing and key management, it reduces boilerplate while preserving on-chain control.
